scripts.build:android: npm run mkdist && react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform android --dev true --bundle-output dist/main.android.jsbundle --assets-dest dist/res
scripts.build:ios: npm run mkdist && react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev true --bundle-output dist/main.ios.jsbundle --assets-dest dist
scripts.bundle:baseline:ios: npm run mkdist && HYPERION_BENCHMARK_BASELINE=1 react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev false --minify true --bundle-output dist/baseline.ios.jsbundle
scripts.bundle:fixture:ios: npm run mkdist && react-native bundle --entry-file index.js --platform ios --dev false --minify true --bundle-output dist/fixture.ios.jsbundle
scripts.benchmark:bundle:ios: npm run bundle:baseline:ios && npm run bundle:fixture:ios && node benchmark/report-bundle-size.cjs
scripts.benchmark:hermes:ios: node_modules/react-native/sdks/hermesc/osx-bin/hermesc -emit-binary -O -out dist/baseline.ios.hbc dist/baseline.ios.jsbundle && node_modules/react-native/sdks/hermesc/osx-bin/hermesc -emit-binary -O -out dist/fixture.ios.hbc dist/fixture.ios.jsbundle && node benchmark/report-bundle-size.cjs
